newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran hangs thief who shot uncooperative locksmith.
newsitem.headline: Iran hangs thief who shot uncooperative locksmith.

text.p: A man was executed in Iran for shooting dead a locksmith who refused to help him steal cars by providing him with a master-key, a newspaper said on Tuesday.

The daily Iran said Farhad Mohseni was hanged in a prison in Karaj, 40 km (25 miles) west of Tehran, on Monday for killing Kourosh Hafezi, a young locksmith who took money from him to make the key but apparently had second thoughts later.
